title: OctoHarnessProtocolSchema
description: Serializable data shapes for the Octo Harness NDJSON protocol. Runtime behavior remains hand-written in src/index.ts, and this schema is the source of truth for generated TypeScript types.

MessageChannel.title: MessageChannel
MessageChannel.description: Assistant output channel. analysis identifies reasoning-class content whose exposure must be authorized separately; final is user-facing output.

MessageExposure.title: MessageExposure
MessageExposure.description: Adapter-authenticated classification of analysis content. public_reasoning, public_summary, and public_plan may enter a public Presentation; missing values are unknown.

MessageProvenance.title: MessageProvenance
MessageProvenance.description: Provider-native provenance written by the adapter. Audience projectors use it to audit public exposure and clients cannot override it.

provider.description: Adapter or provider type that produced the message.

nativeEvent.description: Provider-native event type that was normalized.

ProviderSession.title: ProviderSession
ProviderSession.description: Provider-owned session resume data. Core treats sessionId and adapter extension fields as opaque.

resumable.description: Whether the provider declares that later invocations can resume this session.

resumeOutcome.description: Continuity outcome for this session update. Compaction applies to the next turn; fresh fallback applies to the current turn.

resumeFallback.description: Low-cardinality reason for a fresh resume fallback.

contextInputVariant.description: Frozen context input variant actually selected for the current provider turn.

AgentConfig.title: AgentConfig
AgentConfig.description: Persisted agent configuration. Adapters interpret provider-specific extensions while Core only stores and forwards them.

workdir.description: Default provider CLI working directory. It is a cwd, not a filesystem security boundary.

dangerouslyBypassPermissions.description: Whether to bypass permission confirmation. Use only with explicit authorization.

autoApprove.description: Whether tool calls are approved automatically.

thinking.description: Whether provider thinking is enabled, or a legacy provider-specific thinking mode identifier.

effort.description: Optional provider reasoning effort identifier. Provider adapters may define an explicit default.

providerOptions.description: Provider-specific extension options passed through unchanged by Core.

CanonicalEventPayload.title: CanonicalEventPayload
CanonicalEventPayload.description: Shared canonical event payload. The open dictionary carries structured tool, surface, and usage fields while common lifecycle fields remain explicit.

stepId.description: Stable model-step identifier used to associate messages and tool calls with one provider turn.

status.description: Tool call or run status identifier.

ModelStepStartedPayload.title: ModelStepStartedPayload
ModelStepStartedPayload.description: Starts one provider model round. A round may contain public reasoning, tool calls, and text output.

stepId.description: Stable identifier reused by model_step.finished and child events.

startedAtMs.description: Provider-observed round content-start timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

ModelStepFinishedPayload.title: ModelStepFinishedPayload
ModelStepFinishedPayload.description: Finishes one provider model round and records why control returned to the harness.

finishReason.description: Provider-normalized reason such as tool-calls or stop.

publicText.description: Bounded text the provider already emitted on a public final channel during this round. This is a display fallback, not private reasoning.

endedAtMs.description: Provider-observed round finish timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

ToolCallCreatePayload.title: ToolCallCreatePayload
ToolCallCreatePayload.description: Formal tool_call.create payload. args preserves the original structured input, including args.command for shell tools.

id.description: Stable tool call identifier reused by later delta and update events.

args.description: Original structured input known when the tool call starts. Streaming providers may begin empty and append argsDelta.

ToolCallDeltaPayload.title: ToolCallDeltaPayload
ToolCallDeltaPayload.description: Formal tool_call.delta payload. argsDelta is an ordered raw JSON fragment and must be concatenated before parsing.

id.description: Stable identifier from the corresponding tool_call.create event.

argsDelta.description: Raw JSON argument fragment; do not parse fragments independently.

ToolCallUpdatePayload.title: ToolCallUpdatePayload
ToolCallUpdatePayload.description: Formal tool_call.update payload that closes the tool lifecycle and carries its final result.

id.description: Stable identifier from the corresponding tool_call.create event.

status.description: Terminal tool status such as completed, error, failed, or cancelled.

output.description: Final tool output as text or structured JSON.

exitCode.description: Process exit code for command tools.

RunIdentity.title: RunIdentity
RunIdentity.description: Stable run identity used by envelopes without requiring the complete domain object.

ChannelScope.title: ChannelScope
ChannelScope.description: Platform-neutral channel isolation key. account_id may be null but remains explicit; an absent thread_id selects the conversation root.

ChannelMessagePart.title: ChannelMessagePart
ChannelMessagePart.description: Normalized platform message part. type and text are common fields; connector extensions remain untrusted external data.

ChannelMessageSender.title: ChannelMessageSender
ChannelMessageSender.description: Normalized sender fact without platform credentials.

ChannelMessageFlags.title: ChannelMessageFlags
ChannelMessageFlags.description: Common message flags that affect context projection. Self and control messages are excluded from provider-visible context.

ChannelMessageFact.title: ChannelMessageFact
ChannelMessageFact.description: A platform-neutral message fact in the rebuildable channel journal. Message content is always untrusted external input.

ChannelContextAppend.title: ChannelContextAppend
ChannelContextAppend.description: Idempotent context-only batch appended by agent-worker to its bound daemon.

ContextSyncRequest.title: ContextSyncRequest
ContextSyncRequest.description: Bounded backfill requested by the daemon after cold start or gap detection. It never carries platform tokens.

ContextSyncResult.title: ContextSyncResult
ContextSyncResult.description: Bounded history result. complete means only that the requested window was returned, not that the local journal is authoritative.

ChannelContextDescriptor.title: ChannelContextDescriptor
ChannelContextDescriptor.description: Snapshot selection descriptor in ExecutionEnvelope. Scope, consumer_key, and session_generation isolate the consumption cursor.

ChannelContextSnapshotRef.title: ChannelContextSnapshotRef
ChannelContextSnapshotRef.description: Traceable reference to frozen provider-visible context. The primary and recovery hashes cover their exact rendered bytes.

source_session_generation.description: Original descriptor generation when recovery promotes the effective consumer generation.

recovery_rendered_sha256.description: Hash of the frozen bounded cold projection used when provider resume falls back to a fresh session.

recovery_completeness.description: Completeness of the frozen cold recovery projection.

ContextCommitResult.title: ContextCommitResult
ContextCommitResult.description: Result of advancing the consumer cursor with version CAS after terminal durability.

InvokeRequestWire.title: InvokeRequestWire
InvokeRequestWire.description: Serializable execution request sent from Core to Adapter Host. AbortSignal is added in src/index.ts because it cannot cross a process boundary.

invocationId.description: Active Adapter Host invocation identifier and cancellation target.

sessionId.description: Long-lived Harness session identifier for the chat or task.

prompt.description: Display-safe current request or task description. It excludes hidden channel context and provider control parameters.

modelInput.description: Exact provider-visible user turn. Adapters fall back to prompt when this field is absent.

freshFallbackModelInput.description: Frozen alternate user turn for the first turn of a fresh provider session after resume fails.

workdir.description: Provider process cwd. Sandboxing, containers, or host permissions provide the actual access boundary.

appendInstructions.description: Harness-generated control instructions placed in a provider-native private carrier by the adapter.

context.description: Structured Harness context for prompts, auditing, and future transports.
